items.source: JdbcChatMemoryRepository does not support tool call messages. AssistantMessage instances containing tool calls and ToolResponseMessage instances are silently filtered out on save and will not appear in the retrieved conversation history. If your application uses tool calling, consider the Spring AI Session project and the JDBC session store, which properly persist all message types.

items.source: When eviction is needed, MessageWindowChatMemory always removes whole turns rather than cutting mid-turn. A turn starts at a UserMessage and includes all subsequent assistant replies, tool calls, and tool responses up to the next UserMessage. If the raw eviction point lands on a non-user message (for example, an assistant reply in the middle of a tool-calling exchange), the cut is advanced forward to the next UserMessage so that the kept window always begins at a complete turn.
items.translation: 当需要驱逐时，MessageWindowChatMemory 总是移除整个回合，而不是在回合中间截断。一个回合始于一个UserMessage，并包含直到下一个UserMessage之前的所有后续助手回复、工具调用和工具响应。如果原始驱逐点落在非用户消息上（例如，处于工具调用交换过程中的助手回复），则会将截断点向前推进到下一个UserMessage，以确保保留的窗口始终从完整的回合开始。

items.source: Messages are retrieved in ascending order (oldest-to-newest), which is the expected format for LLM conversation history. Ordering is maintained by a sequence_id column that records each message’s position within its conversation. Each message also stores a creation timestamp, exposed in the message metadata under the JdbcChatMemoryRepository.CONVERSATION_TS key as a java.time.Instant, so applications can display when a message was created.
items.translation: 消息按升序（从旧到新）检索，这是 LLM 对话历史预期的格式。顺序由记录每条消息在其对话中位置的 `sequence_id` 列维护。每条消息还存储一个创建时间戳 `timestamp`，该时间戳在消息元数据下通过 `JdbcChatMemoryRepository.CONVERSATION_TS` 键暴露为 `java.time.Instant`，以便应用程序可以显示消息的创建时间。

items.source: The ChatMemory abstraction allows you to implement various types of memory to support different use cases. The underlying storage of the messages is handled by the ChatMemoryRepository, whose sole responsibility is to store and retrieve messages. It’s up to the ChatMemory implementation to decide which messages to keep and when to remove them. Examples of strategies could include keeping the last N messages, keeping messages for a certain time period, or keeping messages up to a certain token limit.
items.translation: `ChatMemory` 抽象允许您实现各种类型的内存以支持不同的使用场景。消息的底层存储由 `ChatMemoryRepository` 处理，其唯一职责是存储和检索消息。具体保留哪些消息以及何时移除它们，则由 `ChatMemory` 的实现来决定。策略示例包括保留最后 N 条消息、保留特定时间段内的消息，或保留直到达到某个令牌限制的消息。

items.source: The ChatMemory abstraction is designed to manage the chat memory. It allows you to store and retrieve messages that are relevant to the current conversation context. However, it is not the best fit for storing the chat history. If you need to maintain a complete record of all the messages exchanged, you should consider using a different approach, such as relying on Spring Data for efficient storage and retrieval of the complete chat history.
items.translation: `ChatMemory` 抽象类旨在管理对话记忆，允许您存储和检索与当前对话上下文相关的消息。然而，它并非存储对话历史的最佳选择。如果您需要维护所有交换消息的完整记录，应考虑采用其他方法，例如依赖 Spring Data 来高效地存储和检索完整的对话历史。

items.source: Spring AI auto-configures a ChatMemory bean that you can use directly in your application. By default, it uses an in-memory repository to store messages (InMemoryChatMemoryRepository) and a MessageWindowChatMemory implementation to manage the conversation history. If a different repository is already configured (e.g., Cassandra, JDBC, or Neo4j), Spring AI will use that instead.
items.translation: Spring AI 会自动配置一个ChatMemory Bean，您可以直接在应用程序中使用它。默认情况下，它会使用内存存储库来保存消息（InMemoryChatMemoryRepository），并使用MessageWindowChatMemory实现来管理对话历史。如果已经配置了不同的存储库（例如 Cassandra、JDBC 或 Neo4j），Spring AI 将使用该存储库。

items.source: MessageWindowChatMemory maintains a sliding window of messages up to a specified maximum size. When the number of messages exceeds the maximum, older messages are evicted while always preserving SystemMessage instances. The default window size is 20 messages.

items.source: The ChatMemory abstraction allows you to implement various types of memory to suit different use cases. items.source: Spring AI offers the ChatMemoryRepository abstraction for storing chat memory. This section describes the built-in repositories provided by Spring AI and how to use them, but you can also implement your own repository if needed.
items.translation: Spring AI 提供了用于存储聊天记忆的 `ChatMemoryRepository` 抽象。本节介绍了 Spring AI 提供的内置仓库及其使用方法，但如有需要，您也可以自行实现自己的仓库。

items.source: JdbcChatMemoryRepository is a built-in implementation that uses JDBC to store messages in a relational database. It supports multiple databases out-of-the-box and is suitable for applications that require persistent storage of chat memory.
items.translation: JdbcChatMemoryRepository 是一个内置实现，使用 JDBC 将消息存储到关系型数据库中。它开箱即支持多种数据库，适用于需要持久化存储聊天记忆的应用程序。

items.source: CassandraChatMemoryRepository uses Apache Cassandra to store messages. It is suitable for applications that require persistent storage of chat memory, especially for availability, durability, scale, and when taking advantage of time-to-live (TTL) feature.
items.translation: CassandraChatMemoryRepository 使用 Apache Cassandra 存储消息。它适用于需要持久化存储聊天记忆的应用程序，特别是在对可用性、耐久性、可扩展性以及利用时间到活（TTL）功能有需求时。

items.source: CassandraChatMemoryRepository has a time-series schema, keeping record of all past chat windows, valuable for governance and auditing. Setting time-to-live to some value, for example three years, is recommended.
items.translation: `CassandraChatMemoryRepository` 采用时间序列架构，用于保存所有历史聊天窗口的记录，这对于治理和审计至关重要。建议将生存时间（time-to-live）设置为某个值，例如三年。

items.source: RedisChatMemoryRepository is a built-in implementation that uses Redis Stack (with Redis Query Engine and RedisJSON) to store chat messages. It is suitable for applications that require high-performance, low-latency chat memory persistence with optional TTL (time-to-live) support and advanced querying capabilities.
items.translation: RedisChatMemoryRepository 是一个内置实现，利用 Redis Stack（包含 Redis Query Engine 和 RedisJSON）来存储聊天消息。它适用于需要高性能、低延迟聊天记忆持久化的应用程序，并支持可选的 TTL（生存时间）功能和高级查询能力。

items.source: The repository stores messages as JSON documents and creates a search index for efficient querying. It also provides extended query capabilities through the AdvancedRedisChatMemoryRepository interface for searching messages by content, type, time range, and metadata.
items.translation: 该仓库以 JSON 文档形式存储消息，并创建搜索索引以实现高效查询。此外，它通过 `AdvancedRedisChatMemoryRepository` 接口提供扩展的查询功能，支持按内容、类型、时间范围和元数据搜索消息。

items.source: Large language models (LLMs) are stateless, meaning they do not retain information about previous interactions. This can be a limitation when you want to maintain context or state across multiple interactions. To address this, Spring AI provides chat memory features that allow you to store and retrieve information across multiple interactions with the LLM.
items.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）是无状态的，这意味着它们不会保留之前交互的信息。当需要在多次交互之间保持上下文或状态时，这可能成为一个限制。为了解决这个问题，Spring AI 提供了聊天记忆功能，允许您在与大型语言模型的多次交互中存储和检索信息。

items.source: Before choosing a memory type, it’s essential to understand the difference between chat memory and chat history.

items.source: The Neo4j repository will automatically ensure that indexes are created for conversation IDs and message indices to optimize performance. If you use custom labels, indexes will be created for those labels as well. No schema initialization is required, but you should ensure your Neo4j instance is accessible to your application.
items.translation: Neo4j 存储库将自动为对话 ID 和消息索引创建索引以优化性能。如果您使用自定义标签，也将为这些标签创建索引。无需执行模式初始化，但请确保您的 Neo4j 实例可被应用程序访问。

items.source: Messages are retrieved in ascending timestamp order (oldest-to-newest), which is the expected format for LLM conversation history. This ordering is consistent across all chat memory repository implementations.
items.translation: 消息按时间戳升序（从旧到新）检索，这是大型语言模型对话历史所需的预期格式。此排序在所有聊天记忆存储库实现中均保持一致。

items.source: The PromptTemplate provided here customizes how the advisor merges retrieved memory with the system message. This is distinct from configuring a TemplateRenderer on the ChatClient itself (using .templateRenderer()), which affects the rendering of the initial user/system prompt content before the advisor runs. See ChatClient Prompt Templates for more details on client-level template rendering.
items.translation: 此处提供的 PromptTemplate 自定义了顾问如何将检索到的记忆与系统消息合并。这与在 ChatClient 本身配置 TemplateRenderer（使用 .templateRenderer()）不同，后者影响的是在顾问运行之前对初始用户/系统提示内容的渲染。有关客户端级模板渲染的更多详细信息，请参阅ChatClient 提示模板。

items.source: If maxMessages is smaller than a single complete turn (for example, a multi-step tool-calling exchange that exceeds the window size), all non-system messages may be evicted until a new UserMessage is added. Size maxMessages generously enough to hold at least one representative turn for your use case.
items.translation: 如果 maxMessages 小于单个完整轮次（例如，超过窗口大小的多步工具调用交互），所有非系统消息都可能会被驱逐，直到添加一个新的 UserMessage。请根据您的需求，将 maxMessages 设置得足够大，以确保至少能容纳一个代表性的轮次。

items.source: As of 2.0.0, the schema adds a sequence_id column that determines message ordering, alongside the existing timestamp column (now exposed via message metadata). Upgrading an existing application requires adding the new column; see Upgrade Notes for the migration steps.
items.translation: 自 2.0.0 版本起，架构新增了一个 sequence_id 列用于确定消息顺序，同时保留了现有的 timestamp 列（现已通过消息元数据暴露）。升级现有应用程序需要添加此新列；迁移步骤请参阅升级说明。

items.source: The ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID parameter is required for all memory advisors. Calls that omit this parameter will throw an IllegalArgumentException at runtime. There is no default conversation ID.
items.translation: 对于所有记忆顾问，ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID 参数是必需的。如果调用时省略此参数，将在运行时抛出 IllegalArgumentException 异常。不存在默认的会话 ID。

items.source: Currently, the intermediate messages exchanged with a large-language model when performing tool calls are not stored in the memory. This is a limitation of the current implementation and will be addressed in future releases. If you need to store these messages, refer to the instructions for the User Controlled Tool Execution.
items.translation: 目前，在执行工具调用时与大语言模型交换的中间消息不会存储在内存中。这是当前实现的局限性，将在未来的版本中解决。如果您需要存储这些消息，请参考用户控制的工具执行中的说明。
